messages:
Mira: quick sync — Acme (Dedicated customer on our shared-gpu pool) wants a canary rollforward that never goes above 20% and must be gateable by their SREs. Can we do per-tenant constraints (max percent, cpu caps, manual approval points) via API + console?
Alan: we currently have global trafficSplit, per-model. per-tenant splits are possible but not gated. need guardrails: maxShare, cpuQuota, requireApproval flags.
Sophia: prefer policy layer in control-plane instead of plumbing into runtime. control-plane validates rollout config and emits routing changes. simpler to audit.
Jack: console UX idea — "safety profile" presets: conservative(5%), standard(20%), fast(50%). enterprise customers can lock presets. shows last successful checkpoint.
Ops: a couple of notes — if tenant is on an isolated pool the canary semantics differ (split=100%). we should only expose staged rollouts for tenants using shared allocations.
Mira: Acme is on a shared-dedicated cluster (they share a reserved pool); they asked specifically for staged ramping with manual approval at 5% and 15% checkpoints.
Alan: proposed minimal API: POST /rollouts { tenantId, model, variant, steps: [{percent, durationMins, requiresApproval, maxCpuP95}] } with server-side validation that percent <= tenant.max_canary or org default. Example:
```
POST /rollouts
{
  "tenantId": "acme",
  "model": "redwood-3b",
  "variant": "v2",
  "steps": [
    {"percent": 5, "durationMins": 30, "requiresApproval": true},
    {"percent": 15, "durationMins": 45, "requiresApproval": true}
  ]
}
```
Sophia: control-plane will translate steps -> routing policy updates (route.weight overrides). must also snapshot baseline metrics before step starts. telemetry required: per-step latency, error-rate, cost/dollar delta.
Ops: telemetry metrics we want: canary_step_started, canary_step_succeeded, canary_step_failed, canary_step_rollback. dashboards: per-tenant canary health with p95/p99, errors, cost delta, tokens/sec.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started tenant=acme model=redwood-3b variant=v2 step=1 percent=5 timestamp=1945001240
Jack: Console UX: show live percent, health badge, and inline actions: pause / rollback / promote. add "locked-by-enterprise" badge if org policy blocks changing steps. link to audit logs + approver list.
Mira: also Legal wants KMS usage audit for any canary traffic that touches customer data — note for Private deployments + Dedicated with customer-managed keys.
Alan: edge-case: backend capacity constraints. if routing push fails due to node OOM or queue saturation, we should auto-decouple: reduce percent back to last stable and create a blocking alert rather than hard-fail the rollout. propose: on failure -> rollback to previous stable, then mark rollout as "blocked-by-capacity".
Sophia: agree and add guard thresholds: min_throughput and max_token_latency per-step. if thresholds violate for X minutes -> pause and require manual resume.
Ops: I'll author alert rules (PagerDuty + slack channel + runbook link). who wants the API contract PR so I can wire dashboards?
Mira: I'll write a short RFC with console mockups and the required telemetry + runbook checklist. assigning API schema PR to @alan and console mockups to @jack. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
